approval_source: Explicit user SIGA in HNK-LINGUAS after SWHNK-C1-PROGRESS-SNAPSHOT-V56 identified this design batch as the sole next gate.

decisions_requested.statement: Confirm L02-STR-005 must satisfy the canonical Cycle 1 content requirement 'I didn't...' and may not be replaced by EN + SAROSARI + KE.
Approve FIRST_PERSON_NEGATED_PAST_EVENT_OR_ACTIVITY as the semantic target while keeping approved_form null.
Allow AN to be evaluated as the governed first-person component without promoting it beyond CANDIDATE.
Allow NE to enter a separate L02 scope-extension review for negation; this decision does not yet apply that extension.
Keep PA strictly lexical 'ontem'; do not map PA to generic PAST or English DID.
Do not assume declarative order AN + NE + PREDICATE, PA + AN + NE + PREDICATE, or any alternative until a dedicated pattern review is prepared.
Do not invent a DID auxiliary, tense morpheme, negation lexeme, or new predicate to satisfy the slot.
Prepare a joint NE-L02 scope-extension review plus exact STR005 pattern review; keep STR005 MISSING until that later pattern gate is explicitly approved.
